translations.web: All the princes, the mighty men, and also all of the sons of king David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.
translations.bsb: All the officials and mighty men, as well as all of King David’s sons, pledged their allegiance to King Solomon.
translations.kjv: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.
